about: What --check asserts for this template beyond the common rules: the builder and the red team ran as their own subagents; the red team wrote only under traces/ (its owns) and nobody else wrote there; the run ended by the pass edge to the stop node or by diminishing returns. The design bet (write-up): the first hardening leaves something the red team can reproduce, so at least one trace is written and e-red-team-fail is taken.
